TRIP_Evidence: Initial specimen is single FCC; after tensile fracture XRD indexes only FCC and EBSD reports stable single-phase FCC with no HCP.
TWIP_Evidence: EBSD reports activated <111>60° deformation-twin system and TEM/SAED directly confirms fine deformation twin clusters.
Slip_Evidence: TEM directly shows dislocation pile-ups, dislocation walls and deformation bands.
Notes: This is a high-quality experimental negative TRIP condition and is valuable for class balance.
